Dual raw reports/netlist: 8351.405814 um2, 7139 cells, 1348 FF, 52 logic levels, setup +0.8411 ns, hold +0.0251 ns, macro/blackbox/latch/timing-loop/constraint violations zero.

issues.finding: The 4.546491x number divides a wide-only 2x adapter service-rate ratio by standalone cell area. Neither downstream accumulator nor correction scheduling is present.
issues.required_action: Name it only adapter-only wide-block raw-throughput-per-cell-area proxy; obtain Conv-level throughput/mm2 only from integrated old_psum+delta accumulation and mixed-population replay.

issues.finding: Dual co-read exposes 144 logical/160 physical input bytes per wide cycle, while the serial point peaks at 96 bytes/cycle. SRAM macros, ports, wires, and interconnect are absent from both DC tops.
issues.required_action: Integrate or model matched SRAM/interconnect resources and report throughput/area/port and power Pareto; never call the dual input a free SHARED96 upgrade or the -56.01% a system area reduction.

issues.finding: No mapped equivalence or PrimeTime gate is admitted by M439.
issues.required_action: Run each RTL against its own mapped netlist in Formality, then PrimeTime with slow-max and fast-min libraries explicitly restored; serial and dual RTL are not mutually equivalent designs.

issues.finding: M430's 517041352 cycles and 1.4353753005x versus strong zero remain a cycle-simulator result for four frozen H67 bottleneck Conv3x3. M439 does not connect the full population to mapped RTL or account for its port resources.
issues.required_action: Run the full 51.84M-row mixed narrow/wide adapter-plus-accumulator integration, preserve old_psum+delta semantics, and normalize the 160-byte port before upgrading M430.

issues.finding: Serial includes wide assembly plus a two-entry completed FIFO; dual includes one elastic output entry. The area result is mechanism-local rather than iso-depth.
issues.required_action: Keep this resource difference explicit. It is reasonable because FIFO2 is needed to overlap serial split issue at its advertised rate, but do not generalize it to an equal-buffer architecture claim.

issues.finding: Dual logic depth rises from 34 to 52 and setup margin falls by 0.7172 ns, although both meet 3 ns; the dual critical path crosses wide legality logic into a debug accept counter.
issues.required_action: Retain path endpoints in the report and confirm functional ready/valid plus accumulator paths in PrimeTime after integration.

issues.finding: The SDC provides I/O delay but no input transition or driving-cell model, and uses ideal clock plus ZeroWireload. Final hold slack is only +0.0251 ns after a 25 ps mapping guard.
issues.required_action: Treat timing as prelayout only; use realistic input drivers, propagated/parasitic interconnect, and explicit min-corner linking in the next STA/physical gate.

issues.finding: The dual postcompile design check has one LINT-31 warning because busy and debug_output_full are intentionally shorted aliases.
issues.required_action: This is benign for DC, but constrain or waive it explicitly in Formality so an alias warning is not confused with an unresolved or multi-driver fault.
